CLIENT PRESENTATION MEETING - January 20, 2024

Client: TechCorp Industries
Our Team: Project Manager, Lead Developer, UX Designer

Meeting Objective:
Present progress on Q1 deliverables and gather feedback on new features

Presentation Highlights:
- Demonstrated new dashboard interface with real-time analytics
- Showed prototype of mobile app integration
- Presented timeline for remaining Q1 milestones

Client Feedback:
- Very positive response to dashboard design
- Requested additional export functionality for reports
- Interested in expanding mobile app features
- Approved budget for additional developer resources

Decisions Made:
1. Proceed with export functionality (priority: high)
2. Schedule follow-up meeting for mobile app roadmap
3. Add 2 developers to team starting next month
4. Client will provide sample data for testing by end of week

Next Steps:
- Send detailed proposal for export features
- Prepare mobile app roadmap presentation
- Begin onboarding process for new developers

Follow-up Meeting: February 5, 2024 at 2:00 PM

TEAM STANDUP MEETING - January 15, 2024

Attendees: John, Sarah, Mike, Emily, David

Agenda:
1. Sprint progress review
2. Blockers and challenges
3. Upcoming priorities

Key Points Discussed:
- Completed user authentication module ahead of schedule
- Database migration is 80% complete, expected finish by end of week
- Frontend redesign is on track for next sprint
- Integration testing revealed 3 minor bugs, all assigned and in progress

Blockers:
- Sarah: Waiting on API documentation from external vendor (expected tomorrow)
- Mike: Need access to staging environment (escalated to DevOps)

Action Items:
1. John: Review pull requests by EOD
2. Sarah: Follow up with vendor on API docs
3. Mike: Schedule meeting with DevOps team
4. Emily: Update project timeline with new estimates
5. David: Prepare demo for client review next week

Next Meeting: January 18, 2024 at 10:00 AM
